components.title: Hard rules
components.js: No JS needed: the HTML works with the CSS alone.
components.html:
1. Square corners everywhere, avatars and checkboxes included.
  2. Flat surfaces. No glass, grain, glow or shadow. Fades are for borders and edges only.
  3. Color is for important things: risk, status, success, focus. Everything else is black, white and grey, navigation included.
  4. Motion on state change only: 120–200ms transitions and a one-pass hover shimmer. The rain moves only while work runs.
  5. Minimal by default, detail on expand.
  6. SF Pro for text in regular and medium; Source Code Pro for code.

components.title: Living tables
components.usage: Drag the grip on the trailing edge, or focus it and use the arrow keys. Metadata folds beneath each title as the container narrows. Groups open independently. Width only. Arrow keys move 16px, Shift + arrows move 64px, Home fits the minimum, End fills the parent, and Escape cancels a drag. Requires CSS subgrid and container queries, supported in Chromium 117+ and Safari 16+. Call refresh() after changing rows or groups; remount for a different column schema. Without mounting, this is a readable static table.

components.title: Live feed navigation
components.usage: Focus the feed for j/k, g then t for newest, and n for oldest. Insert a row while reading to keep your place. Rows need stable data-id and numeric data-order. data-sd-open="id" · data-sd-closeOpens a dialog as modal; closes the nearest dialog. Backdrop click closes unless data-sd-static.
popovertarget + .sd-popoverPlaces the popover next to its trigger, flips at edges, keyboard for menus.
role="tab"Selects tabs and panels, arrow keys, roving focus.
data-sd-toggle="id"Opens and closes an .sd-expand, keeps aria-expanded in sync.
data-sd-segSingle-select button group; fires change.
data-sd-key="a"Clicks the element when the key is pressed (ignored while typing).
data-sd-tip="text"Tooltip on hover and focus.
data-sd-copy="#id"Copies text, or explains that copying is unavailable.
data-sd-toast="text"Shows a toast on click.
data-sd-theme="paper"Switches theme and remembers it.
